selection: Up to five fixed-hash NT20-relative gained protein calls per baseline-support stratum, plus every human-annotated gained call, restricted to concordant NR and viral-reference species; up to twelve fixed-hash pairs per call.
limits: Illustrative outcome-selected cases, not a representative accuracy estimate.
Three exact pairs is not the production alignment/similarity exemplar threshold.
Reference intervals come from existing viral-reference alignments, not NR alignments.
Up to five highest-scoring eligible rows retained per mate; ties use subject and coordinates deterministically. The selected-query raw extraction retains every row.
Overlapping intervals can identify concentrated support but cannot prove molecule independence or infection.
